section_summary: This section contains International Telephone & Telegraph Corporation memoranda on Nippon Electric and Sumitomo Electric Industries, including their ownership, finances, factories, patents and licensing arrangements. It includes subsidiary balance sheets and two complete patent and technical information agreements. A third agreement, concerning a 1938 capital increase and shareholding arrangements, continues beyond page 63.

subfiles.title: Nippon Electric Company, Limited
subfiles.about: The memorandum describes Nippon Electric’s ownership, financing, operations and investments.
subfiles.summary: Traces Nippon Electric’s development from a Bell System venture through International Standard Electric Corporation’s changing shareholding and its arrangements with Sumitomo. It describes capital increases, exchange control difficulties, option rights, patent royalties, directors and manufacturing plants. It also lists subsidiaries and related companies, while warning that the available information is incomplete and outdated.

subfiles.title: Sumitomo Electric Industries, Limited, and related agreements
subfiles.about: The memorandum describes Sumitomo Electric’s business, ownership, finances and patent agreements.
subfiles.summary: Explains Sumitomo Electric’s wire and cable business, its intertwined shareholdings with Nippon Electric and International Standard Electric Corporation, and option arrangements shaped by exchange controls. It includes a comparative financial statement, directors, plant information and a list of other licensing agreements. The closing sections index the attached exhibits and estimate the number and value of Japanese and Manchukuo patents.

subfiles.title: Exhibit 1: Agreement between International Standard Electric Corporation and Nippon Electric Company
subfiles.about: The agreement sets terms for technical assistance, patents, distribution and payments.
subfiles.summary: International Standard Electric Corporation undertakes to provide Nippon Electric with engineering, manufacturing, sales and patent assistance, while granting patent and distribution rights in Japan and Manchukuo. Nippon Electric agrees to share information, grant outside distribution rights and pay sales based compensation, generally at two percent subject to exceptions. The agreement also sets confidentiality, audit, duration, governing law, associated company and pricing terms.

subfiles.title: Exhibit 2: Agreement among International Standard Electric Corporation, Nippon Electric and Sumitomo Electric Wire and Cable Works
subfiles.from: International Standard Electric Corporation and Nippon Electric Company, Limited
subfiles.to: Sumitomo Electric Wire and Cable Works, Limited
subfiles.about: The agreement licenses cable patents and technical information to Sumitomo.
subfiles.summary: The parties define the covered telephone and telegraph cables and grant Sumitomo Japanese manufacturing rights under Standard patents. Sumitomo must protect confidential information, pay one percent of covered sales with an annual minimum, and observe sublicensing and export restrictions. The agreement also divides manufacturing fields between Sumitomo and Nippon, provides for board representation and arbitration, and states a term through 1949.

subfiles.title: Exhibit 3: Agreement on Nippon Electric capital increase and related shareholdings
subfiles.from: Sumitomo Honsha, Limited; Sumitomo Electric Wire and Cable Works, Limited; International Standard Electric Corporation
subfiles.about: The parties agree on Nippon Electric’s capital increase, financing and shareholding rights.
subfiles.summary: The agreement provides for increasing Nippon Electric’s capital from 250,000 to 600,000 shares and sets subscriptions by Standard and Sumitomo Honsha. It arranges advances repayable from future dividends and royalties, a purchase of Sumitomo Cable shares, transfer restrictions, and proportional board representation. The text continues beyond page 63.
